workflows.name: Getting Around GNOME
workflows.description: The three keys that open the parts of the shell you cannot see. Each one opens an overlay; Escape closes it and brings you straight back here.

steps.heading: Show all your applications
steps.description: Opens the app grid over your desktop. Everything installed is here, and typing filters it. Press Escape to close it and come back.

steps.heading: Open the notification list
steps.description: Notifications and the calendar live in the same drop-down. Escape closes it again.

steps.heading: Jump straight to your first pinned app
steps.description: Super and a number switches to that app on the dash, launching it if it is not already running. Super+2 is the second, and so on.
